R0261.title: Cross-Attendance-Month Cancellation Arbitrage
R0261.definition: Canceling orders across attendance-month boundaries to arbitrage cross-month settlement and performance differentials.
R0261.description:
Cross-attendance-month cancellation arbitrage exploits courier or site attendance-month and settlement-month boundaries, canceling or modifying orders across months to claim cross-month settlement differentials, performance, and bonuses.

The risk causes duplicated or mismatched settlement and performance expenditure and distorts attendance and settlement data. Detection must combine cancellation timing, attendance-month boundaries, and settlement rules with rate limiting and abnormal verification.
R0261.influence: The risk causes mismatched settlement and performance expenditure, distorts attendance data, and undermines capacity-performance fairness.
